title: Sunflesh Rift closes
desc: Reminder only - tiers lost after close.

title: Overflowing Abundance ends
desc: Recurring farming event - double Talent Level-Up and Weapon Ascension rewards from domains. Runs one week.

title: Imaginarium Theater - monthly reset
desc: New season confirmed for 7.0: Hydro/Electro/Dendro required. Opening chars: Columbina, Xingqiu, Cyno, Kuki Shinobu, Lauma, Kaveh. Your usual pace: start ~3-4 days after reset.

title: The Godforsaken Frostlands ends
desc: MISSED IN ORIGINAL RESEARCH - found during Sep 13 check. Exploration event across 5 new Snezhnaya areas (Volkodlak Tundra, Everfrozen Earth, Fellfrost Peak, Flamefeather Valley, White Birch Snowgrave). Reach 80% exploration in each for 400 Primogems total. Crosses version boundary, no rush.

title: 2v8 mode returns ends
desc: Limited-time return of 2v8 game mode. New Xenomorph killer joins the roster alongside a new Alien Collection.

title: Chemical Leak ends
desc: Navigate gas-filled zones, hunt valves, seal leaks. Earn Event Tokens for exclusive cosmetics catalog - catalog closes permanently after, unspent tokens forfeited.

title: Spiral Abyss - monthly reset
desc: Resets monthly on the 16th. Your usual pace: start ~3-4 days after reset.

title: 6th Anniversary login rewards (verify claim window)
desc: 7.1 launches Sep 23, anniversary itself is Sep 28. Confirmed: 1,600 Primogems, 10 Intertwined Fates, standard 5-star selector, anniversary glider. Claim window length not officially confirmed - estimated 2 weeks, verify in-game.

title: Free event-limited 5-star (finish Snezhnaya Ch. IV by Nov 3)
desc: CONFIRMED: complete Chapter IV of the Snezhnaya Archon Quest by Nov 3, 2026 to claim a free event-limited 5-star character. Real deadline, don't miss.

title: Trekking for Treasures ends
desc: Confirmed dates from official post. Hide-and-seek treasure hunt with Elder Stork in Mohist City. Submit 6-item treasure sets for Pose: Top Seeker, Inscription: Treasure Locator.

title: Bulbasaur's Jump Rope Contest ends
desc: Confirmed dates. Second run of this event. Talk to Bulbasaur at a Pokemon Center to enter.
